Button.usage: MUI's Button: children is its text; variant (text, outlined, contained) with color (inherit, primary, secondary, success, error, info, warning); size, fullWidth, disableElevation, startIcon/endIcon (MUI icon names such as Add, Save, Delete), href, tooltip; onClick.

TextField.usage: MUI's TextField: label, value, placeholder, helperText, type, variant (outlined, filled, standard), size (small, medium), startAdornment/endAdornment (text or an icon name); onChange, onEnterKeyDown, onFocus, onBlur; setValue, clear, focus, blur. The Validation section sets error and required.

MultilineTextField.usage: MUI's TextField multiline: label, value, placeholder, helperText, minRows/maxRows (grows between them), variant, size; onChange; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter fires onEnterKeyDown.

NumberField.usage: A number in MUI's TextField (type number): label, value (a number, empty for none), min, max, step, startAdornment (e.g. $) / endAdornment (e.g. kg), helperText; onChange, onEnterKeyDown; out-of-range input is clamped on blur.

Select.usage: MUI's Select (TextField select): label, options [{label, value}], value (the picked value), helperText, displayEmpty with placeholder, variant, size; selectedOption is exposed; onChange, onOpen, onClose. The menu opens in the popup layer.

Autocomplete.usage: MUI's Autocomplete: label, options [{label, value}], value in MUI's shape (the picked option {label, value} or null; a bare value or label also picks), freeSolo, disableClearable, noOptionsText; inputValue (typed text) exposed; onChange, onInputChange, onOpen, onClose.

AutocompleteMultiple.usage: MUI's Autocomplete multiple: picked options as Chips; value in MUI's shape, an array of options [{label, value}] (bare values also pick); limitTags, disableCloseOnSelect, filterSelectedOptions, chipColor; onChange, onInputChange.

DatePicker.usage: MUI X DatePicker: label, value YYYY-MM-DD, format (display, dayjs tokens, default MM/DD/YYYY), views/openTo (year, month, day), minDate, maxDate, disablePast, disableFuture, helperText; onChange (each edit), onAccept (committed), onOpen, onClose. The calendar opens in the popup layer.

TimePicker.usage: MUI X TimePicker: label, value HH:mm (24-hour), ampm (12-hour display), minutesStep, minTime, maxTime, helperText; onChange, onAccept, onOpen, onClose.

Checkbox.usage: MUI's Checkbox in a FormControlLabel: label, checked, indeterminate, color, size, labelPlacement, helperText; onChange; setChecked, toggle.

Switch.usage: MUI's Switch in a FormControlLabel: label, checked, color, size, labelPlacement (end, start, top, bottom), helperText; onChange; setChecked, toggle.

RadioGroup.usage: MUI's RadioGroup with a FormLabel: label, options [{label, value}], value, row (side by side), color, size, helperText; onChange.

ToggleButtonGroup.usage: MUI's ToggleButtonGroup: options [{label, value}], exclusive (one value; off, value is an array, MUI's shape), value, color, size, orientation, fullWidth; onChange.

Rating.usage: MUI's Rating: label, value (a number, null for none), max, precision ('1', or '0.5' for halves), size, readOnly, highlightSelectedOnly; onChange, onChangeActive (hover, exposed as hover).

Slider.usage: MUI's Slider: label, value, min, max, step, marks, valueLabelDisplay (auto, on, off), color, size; onChange while dragging, onChangeCommitted on release.

Chip.usage: MUI's Chip: label, color (default, primary, secondary, success, error, info, warning), variant (filled, outlined), size, icon (a MUI icon name), deletable; onClick, onDelete.

Alert.usage: MUI's Alert: severity (success, info, warning, error), variant (standard, filled, outlined), title (AlertTitle), children (the message), icon, closable (close button, onClose), actionText (a button, onAction); show, close.

TypographyHeading.usage: MUI's Typography for headings: children, variant h1 to h6 (MUI's scale: h1 is a 96px display size; h4 to h6 suit page and section titles), color (a theme path: text.primary, text.secondary, primary.main...), align, noWrap, gutterBottom.

Typography.usage: MUI's Typography for body text: children, variant (body1, body2, subtitle1, subtitle2, caption, overline), color (a theme path such as text.secondary), align, noWrap.

StatCard.usage: The stat card of MUI's dashboard template (Card, Typography, Chip): title, value with format (auto, number, currency, percent, compact), trend (up, down, neutral) as a coloured Chip with trendLabel (e.g. +25%), interval (e.g. Last 30 days), variant.

DataGrid.usage: MUI X DataGrid (free MIT grid): rows, columns [{field, headerName, type (number, date, boolean), width or flex, align, format (currency, percent, compact, chip), colors}], rowIdField, density (compact, standard, comfortable), checkboxSelection, pageSize (max 100) or autoPageSize, showToolbar (filter, export, quick search), noRowsLabel. Exposes selectedRow, rowSelectionModel (ids), selectedRows, paginationModel, sortModel. onRowClick, onRowSelectionModelChange, onPaginationModelChange, onSortModelChange.

Tabs.usage: MUI's Tabs: tabs [{value, label}], value (the open tab), variant (standard, scrollable, fullWidth), textColor, indicatorColor, centered, orientation; each tab panel holds ToolJet components (slot tab_<value>). onChange; setValue.

Card.usage: MUI's Card: CardHeader title and subheader, variant (outlined, elevation), elevation, raised; CardContent holds ToolJet components (slot body). onClick.

Dialog.usage: MUI's Dialog with a trigger Button on the canvas: title, contentText, confirmText/cancelText (DialogActions), confirmColor (error for destructive), maxWidth (xs to xl), fullWidth, fullScreen, scroll; the body holds ToolJet components in the popup layer (slot body, bodyHeight). onClose, onConfirm, onCancel, onEntered; open, close.

List.usage: MUI's List: items; renderItem 'listItemText' draws ListItemText from primaryField/secondaryField with an Avatar from avatarField, 'components' draws a row of ToolJet components reading {{listItem}} (rowHeight). subheader, dense, divider, pageSize, emptyText. onItemClick with selectedItem exposed.

BarChart.usage: MUI X BarChart: dataset (rows), xAxis (the category: [{dataKey}] or a field name), series ([{dataKey, label, color}] or field names; empty: every numeric field), layout (vertical, horizontal), stack ('total' stacks), valueFormat, colors, grid, hideLegend, borderRadius. onItemClick with clickedItem (the row) and clickedSeries.

LineChart.usage: MUI X LineChart: dataset, xAxis ([{dataKey, scaleType}] or a field name), series ([{dataKey, label, color}] or field names), curve (linear, monotoneX, natural, step), showMark, valueFormat, colors, grid, hideLegend. onAxisClick (nearest x) with clickedItem and clickedIndex.

AreaChart.usage: MUI X LineChart with area series (MUI has no separate area chart): the LineChart props; stack 'total' stacks the areas. onAxisClick.

PieChart.usage: MUI X PieChart: data (MUI's [{id, value, label}], or rows read with labelKey/valueKey), innerRadius (0 pie, e.g. 60 donut), outerRadius, paddingAngle, cornerRadius, arcLabel (none, value, label, percent), valueFormat, colors, hideLegend. onItemClick with clickedItem.

LinearProgress.usage: MUI's LinearProgress with a label: value 0 to 100, variant (determinate, indeterminate, buffer with valueBuffer), color, label, showValue; setValue.

Avatar.usage: MUI's Avatar: src (image URL), alt (the name; its initials show without an image), variant (circular, rounded, square), size in px, color; onClick.

Divider.usage: MUI's Divider: orientation, variant (fullWidth, inset, middle), children (text in the line) with textAlign.

Stepper.usage: MUI's Stepper: steps [{id, label, optional}], activeStep (an index from 0; an id or label also works), orientation, alternativeLabel, nonLinear (clickable steps, onStepClick); onChange; setActiveStep, next, back, reset.

Pagination.usage: MUI's Pagination: count (pages), page (from 1), siblingCount, boundaryCount, variant (text, outlined), shape (circular, rounded), color, size, showFirstButton/showLastButton; onChange; setPage.

Menu.usage: MUI's Menu opened from a Button: children (button text), variant, color, size, items [{label, value, icon, disabled, divider}], anchorOrigin; clickedItem exposed. onItemClick, onOpen, onClose; open, close. The menu opens in the popup layer.
